text: The Glop Family Line is a quest achievement earned for completing the Glop, Son of Glop daily quest ten times in Deepholm.

The Founding of the Order of the Cloud Serpent can be found inside the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum of the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. There are two locations, both on the upper floor: one in the southwest corner, and one in the northeast.

The Greyfoo is a Warcraft song writer and machinima maker. He combines these two talents to make original songs for everyone to enjoy. His main appearance is a night elf rogue who can't get enough of women and always wants more.
__NOTOC__ The Ginormus is a human located at the Thunderdrome in Gadgetzan. He is a member of the Wastewander Bandits and nicknamed the "Ayatollah of Kaja-Cola."
The Guardian's Charge is a chest located in Storm Peaks. It contains the Norgannon's Core.
The Frost Lord's Battle Shroud can be found inside the Ice Chest after defeating Lord Ahune in the Slave Pens.
The Frost Lord's War Cloak can be found inside the Ice Chest after defeating Lord Ahune in the Slave Pens.
The Frostwind Slayer is a quest achievement earned for completing the Frostfire Ridge vignettes.
The Forge, Level 1 is rewarded from Father and Son or Mending A Broken Heart.
The Forge produces both basic components for use by Blacksmiths, as well as armor and weapons ready for battle.
The Gods of Arak is a scroll found at Veil Terokk in the Spires of Arak.
The Great Angler Returns is the third quest to recruit Nat Pagle.
The Forge, Level 2 is unlocked for being level 96 or having your Talador outpost built.
The Forge, Level 3 is unlocked from Working More Orders for completing 250 Work Orders at your Garrison.
The Goreclaw is a raptor located in the Raptor's Maw in Zorammarsh in Tanaan Jungle.
The The Forgemaster's Hammer Head is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
The Grimewalker is a flesh giant located on the Naglfar in the Maw of Souls.

The Folly of Levia Laurence may refer to: *Unholy: The Folly of Levia Laurence *Outlaw: The Folly of Levia Laurence *Fury: The Folly of Levia Laurence *Fire: The Folly of Levia Laurence *Feral: The Folly of Levia Laurence *Elemental: The Folly of Levia Laurence
The Four Horsemen is a Legion quest achievement rewarded for completing the Death Knight Campaign.

The Forging of Truthguard is a vrykul saga discussing the origins of :Truthguard. An excerpt from it describes how Archaedas shaped the great shield, and how Tyr and Ironaya — who had both given pieces of themselves to construct the shield — watched from a distance as the work unfolded.
The Gates of Hell is an achievement earned from defeating the listed bosses in the Tomb of Sargeras on any difficulty.
The Great Gnomeregan Run is a quest available during the micro-holiday of the same name. For race details, see Great Gnomeregan Run.

The Great Collegiate Dungeon Race is a esports event that started on November 7, 2017, with a six-week crusade of Mythic Keystone dungeon races. The teams competed for a share of $20,000 in scholarship prizing.
__NOTOC__ The Golden Beetle is a beetle found in the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum of Temple of the Jade Serpent.
The Golden Serpent is the first boss of Kings' Rest. To activate the serpent one need to use the Serpentine Seal.
The Ground Trembles is an Elemental shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Earthen Attunement, Molten Blast, and Protection of the Elements traits.
The Golden Skipper is a Zandalari-crewed transport that runs between the Port of Zandalar in Zuldazar and Darkspear Isle in the Echo Isles.
The Frigid Boon has a chance to loot from Winter's Kiss herb nodes for herbalists with Herbalism Technique: Winter's Kiss (Rank 2).
The Goroboros is a hydra located in the Ruins of Vashj'ir in the Shimmering Expanse.
The Good Captain's Bindings are a quest reward from Death From Below.
The Grand Reception is a raid achievement that is earned for defeating Abyssal Commander Sivara, Radiance of Azshara, and the Blackwater Behemoth in the Eternal Palace.
The Golden Horn of Rezan was to be an objective of Atal'Dazar: Locking Horns. It is said to be made from a metal similar to ukrite.

The Fourth War is a Battle for Azeroth quest achievement that is earned by completing the entire faction war campaign story for the expansion. Obtaining the achievement rewards the player with the title, "Veteran of the Fourth War".
The Grand Malleare is a charred behemoth located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Grandmaster's Voucher can be found within Grandmaster Vole's Extravagent Tribute in the Ember Court.
The Fracture Chambers was seemingly replaced by Tracking Jaina during the beta.
The Goblinator would cause you to take on the appearance of a Sapper Specialist.

The Forgotten Key drops from end-of-wing bosses in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Characters who leveled through the normal storyline will receive it from Warden Arkoban during The Search for Baine. Characters who leveled through The Threads of Fate will receive the key from the first boss they defeat after reaching level 60. However, it can still only be used while on, or after completing, The Search for Baine.
The Forgotten One is awarded to players who complete The Weak Link, part of the Runecarver quest chain in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Gang's All Here is an expansion feature achievement earned by building each of the following constructs with Abominable Stitching.
The Great Luckydo is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining the great Luckydo with help from Chordy.
The Forces Gather concludes the "Into the Unknown" chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign.
The Grand Design is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating The Jailer within the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ The Great Swog is a hornswog located in a cave at the Roaring Dragonsprings in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The Gentleman Elemental is a reputation achievement earned by Aquire Assistance from Rupert, the Gentleman Elemental]], 30 times during climbing World Quests.
__NOTOC__ The Great Shellkhan is a turtle located in Thaldraszus.

The Future We Make is awarded to players who kill all three of the bosses of the Storm's Fury event in the Primalist Future of Thaldraszus. The event runs every five hours, but the boss that spawns is random, so it may take more than three attempts.
The Forgotten Ring starts from the Unusual Ring object on the floor of Zskera Vault: Az
The Great Halls is a painting by Hudson. It drops from Primal Tsunami in Halls of Infusion.
The Glazer drops from Bubbling Mead and Flowing Honey in Stormsong Valley.

The Fourth Clue consists of a scroll and an arrow with identical text. They are located at the tallest point of Thunder Peak in Ashenvale. A Barrel of Fun is located next to the clue. Interacting with the arrow will equip the Tricked-Out Thinking Cap.
The Horde's Hellscream is an in-game book given as a quest reward during the Harvest Festival, found at Javnir Nashak, outside Orgrimmar in Durotar.
The Highlander's Resolve is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Paladins.
The Highlander's Purpose is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Druids or Rogues.
The Highlander's Will is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Druids or Rogues.
The Highlander's Resolution is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Warriors or Paladins.
The Highlander's Determination is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Hunters or Shamans.
The Highlander's Intent is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Priests, Mages or Warlocks.
The Hunt Continues is the 1st quest in the The Hunt Continues quest chain.
To get this quest you first have to kill Hakkar the Soulflayer in Zul'Gurub and retrieve the Heart of Hakkar.
The Human, Ras Frostwhisper is the first quest in the quest chain.
The Ahn'Qiraj War Effort must be currently active on the server to receive The Horde Needs Your Help!

__NOTOC__ The Hungering Cold is a tanking one-handed sword and also a great offhander for rogues. Fury warriors benefit from this item as well, as its fast speed makes them generate rage significantly faster than they would have with a slow weapon such as Gressil, Dawn of Ruin.
The Hammer of Grace is a Level 51 quality One-Handed Mace that improves Intellect, Stamina and Versatility.
__NOTOC__ The Husk is a rare bog beast found in the Western Plaguelands.

The Hammer May Fall is the first step in the Hammer May Fall quest chain that starts with Tallow in Tarren Mill. Though it starts in Hillsbrad Foothills, the whole quest chain takes place in Arathi Highlands, killing trolls and ogres.
The Hexxer's Cover is cloth head armor suitable for any caster.
The Hand of Antu'sul is a quality one-hand mace with a nice proc.
Enough with the minions, already. Time to get the guy keeping the portal functioning. This quest is part of the quest chain.

This quest starts the quest chain, allowing access to Stonewrought Pass between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge. The quest is started by Margol's Gigantic Horn, a drop from Margol the Rager, a level 43 mob found in Searing Gorge.
The Heart of Evil is the ninth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.

This quest is part of the introduction to The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. This quest is repeatable until players reach reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu.
The Head of the Hand of Kargath drops from the Hand of Kargath in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Hunter's Path is the starter quest for the Dwarf Hunter quest chain to get pet skills. It is acquired from class trainers.
The Horseman's Helm is an plate head armor. This is the Headless Horseman's head gear. It has a natural fiery green armor glow. It seems to have a unique model.
The High Chief's Key drops from High Chief Bristlelimb in Bloodmyst Isle.
The Hunt for Illidan is the sixth standard set in the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game, and the third part of the Burning Crusade Block. It was released on
The Half Shell is a giant turtle boat moored in Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.
The Horde Art Card Set is a card set from [http://entertainment.upperdeck.com/wow/en/ Upper Deck Entertainment].
the Hallowed is a title rewarded upon completing the Hallow's End World Events meta-achievement Hallowed Be Thy Name. The title will appear after the character's name, like this: : the Hallowed
The Hundred Club (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Sapphiron in Naxxramas on 25-player mode without any member of the raid having a frost resist value over 100.
The Idle Crown of Anub'arak dropped from Anub'arak in Azjol-Nerub on heroic mode.
The Highlander's Fortitude is the Alliance Arathi Basin set set for Hunters or Shamans.
The Horseman's Horrific Helm is an plate head armor. This is the Headless Horseman's head gear. It has a natural fiery green armor glow.
* The Heart of the Matter (Hillsbrad Foothills) * The Heart of the Matter (Slave Pens) * The Heart of the Matter (Uldum)

Discover how orc Chieftain Hargal was killed by collecting the following artifacts: *Tiny Bronze Scorpion *Gray Candle Stub *Maul of Stone Guard Mur'og *Rusted Steak Knife These artifacts are all Orcish in origin, requiring a minimum archaeology skill of 300 to acquire the Orc Archaeology Fragments they require.
The Human Spirit is one of the racial traits granted to all human characters. It increases all secondary stats (Haste, Critical Strike, Mastery, Versatility) from all sources.
The Horseman's Horrific Helmet is an plate head armor. This is the Headless Horseman's head gear. It has a natural fiery green armor glow.
The Horseman's Sinister Saber drops from the Headless Horseman, a summon-able boss during the Hallow's End seasonal event.
The Guardians of Hyjal is an achievement gained by getting with the Guardians of Hyjal in Mount Hyjal.

The Hozen Ravage is a wood-panel scroll found at , leaning against the stone altar of a giant hozen idol on the northern end of the Dooker Dome, at the northwestern end of the Burlap Trail in central Kun-Lai Summit. Interacting with the scroll is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement Hozen in the Mist.
The Horseman's Horrific Hood is an plate head armor. Its stats scale to your level when acquired. This is the Headless Horseman's head gear. It has a natural fiery green armor glow.
The Horseman's Sinister Slicer is an epic one-handed sword. Its stats scale to your level when acquired.
The Horseman's Ring is an ring. Its stats scale to your level when acquired.
The Hammer of Folly can be found at the top of Mason's Folly at on the east side of The Veiled Stair, above the Valley of the Four Winds. Looting it awards ~300,000 XP.

The Heart of Mokk is a step in helping Fin Fizracket with his sickness, who needs to eat the Heart of Mokk as a cure. However, Mokk the Savage isn't easy to find. One needs to enlist the help of Witch Doctor Unbagwa by giving him one gorilla fang.
The Heart of Fernus drops from Fernus in the Ruins of Ata'gar in Frostfire Ridge.
The Hood was an orcish member of the Uncrowned located in the Underbelly of Dalaran during the alpha stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. Both he and Mathias Shaw were removed during the alpha.
The Highkeeper's Ward is one of the artifacts used by elemental shamans in World of Warcraft: Legion. It is automatically equipped in the off hand when wielding The Fist of Ra-den.

During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was made available as an item. However, even though the book can still be acquired, the reason of its existence was removed prior to release.
The Hunter of Mages appears in Hall of the Guardian during Finding Ebonchill.
The Hunt for Illidan Stormrage is the continuation of the Illidan Stormrage campaign in Patch 7.1.0.

There are four paladin class campaign quests and missions that share this name: *The Highlord's Command (Nemesis) — If you chose to go after Balnazzar. **The Highlord's Command: Nemesis *The Highlord's Command (Holy Allies) — If you chose to seek allies. **The Highlord's Command: Holy Allies *The Highlord's Command (Legion Defense) — If you chose to defend against demon attacks. **The Highlord's Command: Legion Defense *The Highlord's Command (Procuring Supplies) — If you chose to procure supplies. **The Highlord's Command: Procuring Supplies
The Hexxer's Head dropped from Jin'do the Hexxer in Zul'Gurub.
The Honorable is a title obtained by earning Prestige Level 5. The title precedes the character's name in the following format: :The Honorable
The Hornet is a wasp located in the Westwind Weald in Tiragarde Sound.
The Horde Uprising sends players in the direction of Mathias Shaw before heading to Silithus, right up until Shaw runs into Anduin and the player to reveal some important updates...
Seek The Guidance of Our Shan'do and put an end to this madness.
The Hungering Maw is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.
The Hivemind is a floating multi-seat mount in the form of a giant brain which can be obtained after solving a secret riddle.
The Hungry Riverbeast is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard and Frostwall Shipyard.
The Happy Bobber is a fishing shop located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. It's run by Old Man Heming.
The Houndmaster's Stratagem is a Demonology warlock talent. It grants the player additional shadowflame damage for 12 seconds after casting Call Dreadstalkers.
The Hand of In'zashi is a Zandalari golem located in the Halls of Opulence in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid.
The Hardiron is a siege engine located in Zuldazar during Faction Assaults.
The Hivekiller is a ravager wasp located in Stormsong Valley.
The Highlord Calls begins the Torghast, Tower of the Damned storyline, part of the Shadowlands campaign. To begin this quest, players must have completed the first chapter of their Covenant Campaign.
The Hoot of the Issue is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating Alderyn and Myn'ir, and Splinterbark Nightmare in a Trial of Loyalty as Mikanikos.
The Hunter's Guide to Being Useful is a tome located in the Trueshot Lodge.
The Houndmaster's Fancy Pants drop from Houndmaster Ely in Stormheim.
The Harvest is a coffin located in the Abandoned Purlieu in Revendreth. It is unlocked by Harvest Key. The Note What Says Where You Put The Key offers hints for locating the key.

.]] The Heartwarming Pack was a bundle that included a transmog set, four mounts and three companions available from the Battle.net Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle was available from 20 December 2022 to 2 January 2023.

The Guardian Pack was a bundle that included three transmog items, available from 4 May 2023 to 31 May 2023 from the Battle.net Shop or In-Game Store. This pack was advertised as a way to gain "early access" to the appearances, which were slated to appear on the Trading Post sometime between September and December 2023. The and Feathered Drape of the Guardian both appeared in October 2023.

The High Scholar's Pack is a bundle that includes a transmog set with Trader's Tender, available from 1 September 2023 to 31 October 2023 from the Battle.net Shop. The transmog set will appear no later than three months after October 31 in the Trading Post.
The Highest Honor becomes available after reaching Renown 25 with the Maruuk Centaur. Completing this quest also awards the title 'Khansguard ' and unlocks access to A Whispering Breeze.

"The Lich King Triumphant" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter V. It recounts events of the undead campaign of Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. Found at: * Reliquary of Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme Timeline: * ← Previous book: Civil War in the Plaguelands * → Next book: Old Hatreds - The Colonization of Kalimdor
The Legend of Stalvan is a book provided and an objective of the quest The Fate of Stalvan Mistmantle.
The Light and How to Swing It drops from all bosses in Dire Maul, and can be found inside of Dusty Tomes in the same instance.
The Jade Eye is a mid-level uncommon ring designed for tanking.
This quest is part of Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
The Judge's Gavel is a quality Two-Handed Mace that has a chance on hit to stun it's target.
The Keystone drops from Commander Sarannis in The Botanica of Tempest Keep.
__NOTOC__ Having discovered the corruption in the cave, and having spotted The Kurken, you are now asked to go back in and slay it. This quest is part of the quest chain.
Nice trophy, that. How about putting it to more practical use? This quest is part of the quest chain.
The Lexicon Demonica is part of a quest line to obtain some anti-Demon weapons.
The Jeremiah Blues is part of the Horde Better Late Than Never quest chain. This quest chain starts with Better Late Than Never (Classic).
The prerequisite for this quest is Disharmony of Flame. Upon turning that quest in, Lagrave will whisper you and this quest will be available.
The Lady Mehley is a human crewed vessel that allows transportation between Menethil Harbor and Theramore Isle.
__NOTOC__ The Kurken is a nian found in Stillpine Hold on Azuremyst Isle. Kurz the Revelator thinks the Kurken was brought to the Hold by the invading wildkin led by Chieftain Oomooroo.

]] ]] The Iron Eagle is a zeppelin, with a goblin crew and orc guards, which runs between Orgrimmar and Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. It docks at Orgrimmar's eastern zeppelin tower and at the tower inside Grom'gol. The captain claims it used to be a warship whose "mere shadow was enough to rout armies", but the crew remains doubtful of this fact.
The Lich's Spellbook was contained in Gunther's Books in Tirisfal Glades.
The Jewel of the Southsea is a chest found in a ship off the Merchant Coast between Ratchet and Northwatch Hold in the Barrens. Opening it would cause Polly to attack.
The Legacy of the Aspects is located in the western half of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale. Though it can no longer be interacted with on retail, it's still present.
A tale of a teacher infatuated with one of his students. The quests are level 28 and above; you are offered the initial quest as low as level 22.
The Light of Dawn came after the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel, the final battle for a death knight in service of the Lich King...
The Lifewarden's Wrath is a quest in the Waygate quest chain in Sholazar Basin.
The Journey is the second story in Warcraft: Legends Volume 1. *Written by Troy Lewter *Art by Mi-Young No *Edited by Troy Lewter
The Last of Her Kind is part of The Sons of Hodir quest chain.
The Incredible Hulk is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for forcing Svala Sorrowgrave to kill a Scourge Hulk on Heroic difficulty in Utgarde Pinnacle.
The Interrogator drops from Drakos the Interrogator in the Oculus on heroic mode.
The Key drops from Lavanthor in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.

The Leaper is a geist found at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown. Initially, The Leaper is under the control of the Lich King and hostile to players. As part of the quest chain to take over the Shadow Vault, he is freed from the Lich King's control, helps defeat General Lightsbane, and becomes affiliated with the Knights of the Ebon Blade. He appears as a quest giver after the player completes The Duke. The Leaper is also one of the dozens of past NPC's encountered by adventurers to assist in killing the elementals at Sethria's Roost.

The Justicar is a meta pvp achievement earned for gaining status with the Stormpike Guard, the Silverwing Sentinels, and the League of Arathor through battles in Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, and Alterac Valley.
The Kur Drakkar is a kvaldir longship found in the mist near Garrosh's Landing in the Borean Tundra.
The Iron Watcher is a level 80 elite iron giant found in Storm Peaks.
The Keepers of Ulduar (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the Keeper bosses of Ulduar on 10-player mode.
The Kirin Tor is an achievement gained by getting with The Kirin Tor in Northrend.
In order to be eligible for this quest, players are required to have earned the achievement .

__NOTOC__ The title the Kingslayer is awarded to players upon completing The Frozen Throne (10 player) or The Frozen Throne (25 player), which is awarded after the death of the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel.

Entry to the dungeon of Scholomance is barred by a locked door. This quest chain serves both to entice characters to explore the plaguelands zones and to reward diligence with access to further adventure. The ultimate reward of this quest is the , which unlocks the door to Scholomance without resort to lockpicking methods.

The Innkeeper's Daughter is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 150 skill to find and 150 Dwarf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Dwarf Rune Stone keystones may be used to complete it.
:Ohmygosh! I didn't think that I was ever going to see anyone ever again! :You have to get me out of here!
The Last Relic of Argus is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 300 skill to find and 130 Draenei Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Draenei Tome keystones may be used to complete it.

The Iron Reaper is a Horde ship floating on the surface above the Shimmering Expanse in Vashj'ir. It is one of three Horde ships in the area searching for survivors of the ships that are wrecked at the start of the Vashj'ir storyline.

The Intrepid is an Alliance boat floating on the surface above the Shimmering Expanse in Vashj'ir. It is one of three Alliance ships in the area searching for survivors of the ships that are wrecked at the start of the Vashj'ir storyline. It is possibly named for the previous ship known as Intrepid that was part of the Third Fleet and sank off the coast of the Wetlands.
The Insane Ghoul sends the adventurer to defeat a ghoul which has another item needed by Viktori.

]] The Judgement is a short story by Brian Kindregan featured on the official site. It is the fifth in the Leaders of Azeroth series, released on April 27, 2011, and centers on the Darkspear trolls' chieftain Vol'jin. In this story, the young Vol'jin and Zalazane undergo trials in order to meet the loa, ultimately revealing their destinies as shadow hunter and witch doctor respectively. It also follows the aftermath of Zalazane's Fall.
The Killem' Jaro is Hemet Nesingwary's hot air balloon at Nesingwary's Safari in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Last Stand is a pile of skulls near Slovan, located at in the Riverblade Den behind Krasari Falls in Krasarang Wilds. Interacting with the skulls is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Between a Saurok and a Hard Place.
The Jade Hunters is a short story by Matt Burns that is featured on the official site.
The Iron Price is an achievement earned from collecting 3 Pristine True Iron Ores and then killing Gruul in Blackrock Foundry in Normal difficulty or higher.
The Jailer's Libram is the paladin class tome found in Ashran. It teaches the Jailer's Judgment spell for 1 hour.
The Joy of Draenor Cooking is an item that unlocks Draenor cooking on a character upon use and teaches a couple of recipes.
The Legion Will NOT Conquer All is a Dungeons & Raids achievement earned for defeating Supreme Lord Kazzak atop the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Tanaan Jungle.
The Iron Houndmaster is an orc located at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle. He is guarded by three wolves.

The Lanticore is a hydra-like creature that very rarely spawns in the Rookery in Upper Blackrock Spire. No one knows what deep part of Blackwing Descent the Lanticore was kept in, but it probably smelled pretty awful.
The Jailer's Cat Tail is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
The Interrogator's Vial is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
The Last Vestiges of the Illidari was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, found in the Scarlet Halls. However, it was removed prior to release.
The Legion Menu is a cooking achievement that can be earned for cooking 15 of the recipes added in the expansion.
The Jade Wisdom is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Lesson of Southshore is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
The Light Saves is a Holy paladin artifact trait. It is linked to the Blessings of the Silver Hand and Share the Burden traits.

]] The Legend of Odyn is a large stone monument located in Skyhold detailing tales and exploits of the Keeper Odyn, sometimes as recounted by Odyn himself. It can be expanded by finding the Lost Legends of Odyn from random drops in Stormheim.
The Kablamminator drops from Peebee Whizzlegear in Thousand Needles.
The Iron Foreman was an orc located in The Pits of Blackrock Foundry Grounds and was taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall and Frostwall garrisons.
The Leviathan is a boat of the Brashtide Crew. Its crew hindered the recruitment of Yancey Grillsen to the Uncrowned, who was in Stranglethorn Vale.
The Indomitable is a battleship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
The Last Wish was a battleship under command of pirate Vhaka the Vile. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Iron Tide was a carrier of the Iron Horde. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Lichen King is a fungarian located in a cave with his fungal throne in Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
Defenders have fallen, so use The Light of Elune to pray for them.
The King's Fang is an Alliance ship crewed by the Gilneas Brigade troops of Greywatch. Under the command of Captain Nuthals, it sits just outside the Cove of Nashal in Stormheim.

The Last Menethil is a Scarlet Brotherhood propaganda pamphlet located in a stand of trees just southwest of Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades. Three other similar pamphlets are lying in the same location: The Cursed Old Wolf, The Traitor King (item), and The Would-Be Queen. Looting it requires level .
The Librarian's Handwraps are a quest reward from Hit the Books.
Thog's Nightlight= |-| Night Terrors= 's lair.]] The Light of Souls is looted from a pedestal in Glopgut's Hollow in the Twilight Highlands.

"The King & The Queen" is the introductory cinematic opening theme for World of Warcraft: Shadowlands. It depicts Sylvanas Windrunner challenging Bolvar Fordragon at the Frozen Throne. It was first shown at BlizzCon 2019.
The Incredible Egg is the beginning quest for eventually obtaining the Shadowbarb Hatchling battle pet. It is started by the Voidtouched Egg found at Ankhaten Harbor in Uldum.

The Incinerator is a furnace found at the Salvage Yard in Frostwall and Lunarfall. This Incinerator is used to open the Bag of Salvaged Goods, Crate of Salvage‎, and Big Crate of Salvage‎. Alliance-side, it is operated by Hennick Helmsley.
__NOTOC__ The Infinite Treatises are found at the Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion.
The Kul Tiran Menu is a profession achievement earned by cooking 10 Kul Tiran recipes.
The Lich's Heart is sold by innkeepers and drink vendors in Maldraxxus.
The Libation is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
The Jailer's Grasp concludes the Patch 9.0 portion of the Shadowlands campaign, and is required to begin the Chains of Domination campaign in patch 9.1.
The Journal of Lin (I) is a tome located in Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes.
The Legend of Emeni, the Kinslayer is a brief epitaph located next to Emeni's remains in Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun during Ember Court: Maldraxxus Army.
The Jailer's Vanguard is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses in the lower floors of the Sanctum of Domination.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 1 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 1 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 2 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 2 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 3 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 3 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 4 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 4 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 5 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 5 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 6 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 6 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 7 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 7 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 8 is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Layer 8 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Jailer is the final boss of the Sepulcher of the First Ones and the Shadowlands expansion.
The Jailer's Defeat begins the optional final chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign, "Judgment".
The Joy of Toy is a collection achievement earned by collecting 500 toys.
The Judgment of Tyr is found inside a tower at the Veiled Ossuary in northern Thaldraszus. Naleidea Rivergleam is looking for it in The Judgment of Tyr.
The Insight of Tyr drops from Reclaimer Makko at Szar Skeleth in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Toddy Whiskers is looking for it in The Insight of Tyr.

The Kalimdor Cup's Introduction introduces players to the Kalimdor Cup, available from 15-28 August.
The Legend of Elun'Ahir is a book found in the Emerald Dream.

The Lost Kris of Zedd is a random drop from trash mobs in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

This set of three Horde-only quests describes the aftermath of Magatha Grimtotem's failed attempt to befriend the troggs in Ragefire Chasm. It consists of a two-part quest and a technically independent third quest and gives a nice boost of XP and Rep to low level characters.

The Maker is the first boss of the Blood Furnace in Hellfire Citadel. The Maker is a fairly simple encounter; most groups of level 60ish characters should have no troubles with him.

__NOTOC__ The Master's Key was the key (and attunement) to enter Medivh's tower of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. It is a reward from the quest Return to Khadgar. In order for your raid to enter Karazhan, only one person needs to possess the key.
The Missing Scout is an Alliance-only quest in which players must locate one of Vindicator Aldar's scouts, named Tolaan.
The Lunar Festival is the th quest in the The Lunar Festival quest chain.
:Were you looking for the Warcraft III item The Lion Horn of Stormwind? The Lion Horn of Stormwind is an trinket.

The Lurker Below is the second boss of the Serpentshrine Cavern in the Coilfang Reservoir. It is widely considered to be the easiest fight in SSC, earning it the nickname "The Loot Below". In order to start the fight, raid members must fish in the "Strange Pool" (needs +300 fishing skill). Each cast has a chance to make the Lurker come to the surface. The success rate of this ranges from 1-2 attempts up to fishing for 8 minutes straight. Some people claim that hitting the center of the pool has a higher chance to summon the Lurker, but this is not confirmed. :Were you looking for the quest The Mark of Vashj (quest)? The Mark of Vashj is a spell cast on the player with the completion of The Cudgel of Kar'desh and returning to Skar'this the Heretic. With this spell cast on the player, they are allowed to enter Serpentshrine Cavern, the lair of Lady Vashj. As of Patch 2.1.2 this is no longer needed to enter SSC. With Patch 2.3, players who complete or have completed the attunement process for SSC/TK will receive the title Champion of the Naaru.

In The Mind's Eye, you must enter the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound and defeat Mai'Zoth to obtain the gem known as the Mind's Eye. Once this is complete, you can finally attempt to save Yenniku, the Darkspear chief's son. This quest is part of a long chain, all available in Grom'gol, the first being Hunt for Yenniku which can be obtained from Nimboya at the north exit to the camp.

The Mark of the Nexus-King is a quest which is completed by finding a Mark of the Nexus-King from one of the Ethereum Stasis Chambers in Bash'ir Landing. Once completed it opens up the Stasis Chambers of the Mana-Tombs which eventually leads to summoning the optional boss Yor in Mana-Tombs. The drop rate of Marks from the Stasis Chambers is not guaranteed, so it may take many attempts to progress this questline.
The Master of Fenris Isle quest chain is a relatively short chain of quests explaining the presence of undead gnolls in Silverpine Forest.
The Mag'har quest brings news of the untainted Outland orc back to the Azerothian orcs.
One of our diplomats is missing! You set out to find out what happened to him. This quest chain is started by Thomas, an altar boy not far inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
This quest is part of the Learning from the Crystals quest chain.

This quest starts the conclusion of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. will only offer this quest after completing the Blue Scepter Shard, Green Scepter Shard and Red Scepter Shard forks.
The Long March is chapter 2 of the Invasion of Kalimdor campaign.
The Map of Zul'Aman is a map of Zul'Aman found on 's platform.
The Lineage of Azeroth's Kings is a book that Garona studied to learn about humans. Later, it was thrown at a demon beast that attacked Khadgar and Garona. This damaged the book.
The Mechagnomes gives you lore-background on the Distress Call quest chain.
The Memoirs of Lord Thorval is a book found in the Scarlet Enclave, written by the death knight of the same name.

The Mighty Wind is a zeppelin with a goblin crew and orc guards that runs between Orgrimmar in Durotar and Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra. The Mighty Wind docks at the east platform of the western zeppelin tower in Orgrimmar and can be easily identified by its unique shape, shark mouth, and floodlights.
The Masquerade is related to the seasonal world event Hallow's End. Completing this achievement is criteria for the meta achievement Hallowed Be Thy Name.
The Love Fool is a title awarded for completing many achievements related to the seasonal world event Love is in the Air, specifically when Fool For Love is completed.
